name: Rava Vegetable Idli
ingredients: ½ cup plain unsweetened soy yogurt
½ cup grated carrot and peas
¼ tsp baking soda or ½ tsp fruit salt
steps: Dry-roast semolina over low heat for 3–4 minutes; cool completely.
Mix soy yogurt, semolina, vegetables, salt and enough water to make a thick spoonable batter. Rest 8 minutes.
Prepare a steamer and lightly grease idli moulds. Just before steaming, fold in baking soda or fruit salt.
Fill moulds two-thirds full and steam 10–12 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
Rest 2 minutes before unmoulding. Serve with sambar or coconut chutney.
note: This vegan adaptation uses soy yogurt. Traditional rava idli often contains dairy; check the semolina and raising-agent labels.
